answer_1.quote: The task of translating natural language questions into query languages (e.g., Text-to‑SQL, Text-to‑Cypher, Text-to‑nGQL) ... we achieve state‑of‑the‑art performance on four Text‑to‑Query benchmarks (Spider, BIRD, Text2Cypher, NL2GQL).
answer_1.outputs: Generated formal queries (SQL, Cypher, nGQL) from natural language questions

answer_2.quote: We use EX and TS metrics on Spider, and EX metric on BIRD to evaluate the generated queries.
